gaps_identified_for_phase_1: Domain interfaces exist only in a single contracts file; require split interface modules and stronger ownership boundaries.
DTOs are centralized in src/detectors/models.py and need domain-scoped model modules with serialization policy.
Pipeline orchestration exists but evaluator/calibration/reporting responsibilities are mixed inside m10_train_detector.py.
Family-group analysis currently collapses event 5..8 as cyber-heavy; concurrent/ambiguous events need explicit group treatment.
No AGENTS.md or PLANS.md existed at repository root before this phase.

principles: Keep src/detectors as canonical module root.
Add new files incrementally and keep compatibility wrappers in existing files during migration.
compatibility_strategy: Keep current imports working by retaining old module paths as wrappers.
Move business logic into new submodules first, then deprecate wrappers in a later phase.
Do not rename m10 pipeline files.

Detector.purpose: Top-level hybrid detector contract for train/eval/infer lifecycle.
Detector.ownership: Owned by src/detectors/runtime.py orchestration and consumed by pipeline entrypoints.
Detector.serialization: Model artifact bundle plus JSON metadata/config snapshot.

BranchDetector.purpose: Common contract for cyber and physical branch implementations.
BranchDetector.ownership: Owned by branch services under src/detectors/cyber and src/detectors/physical.
BranchDetector.serialization: Branch-specific model file + feature schema JSON.

FeatureExtractor.purpose: Build deterministic branch-ready feature matrices from aligned windows.
FeatureExtractor.serialization: No persisted state unless fitted scalers/statistics are required.

Preprocessor.purpose: Convert PMU frames into normalized, aligned, NaN-safe windows with metadata.
Preprocessor.ownership: Owned by shared preprocessing layer; called by dataset builder and infer runner.

FusionStrategy.purpose: Combine cyber and physical scores into calibrated abnormal probability and explainability fields.
methods: fuse(cyber: BranchScore, physical: BranchScore, context: dict[str, Any]) -> BranchScore
FusionStrategy.serialization: Fusion weights/thresholds/calibration params in config JSON.

Postprocessor.purpose: Turn frame-level probabilities into stable decisions and chunk proposals.
methods: chunk(binary: ndarray, timestamps: ndarray, probs: ndarray) -> list[dict[str, Any]]

DetectionInput.purpose: Canonical detector input payload for a frame/window batch.
DetectionInput.type_expectations: x_windows float32/float64; timestamps monotonic per scenario; metadata row count equals n_windows.
DetectionInput.owner: Produced by dataset builder/preprocessor, consumed by branches and fusion.
DetectionInput.serialization: Parquet/NPZ for offline; in-memory dataclass for runtime.

DetectionOutput.purpose: Unified detector output for eval/infer and downstream handoff.
DetectionOutput.type_expectations: Probabilities clipped [0,1], arrays length-aligned to windows.
DetectionOutput.owner: Produced by Detector.predict, consumed by evaluators and inference runners.
DetectionOutput.serialization: CSV/Parquet for frame outputs and JSON for summary diagnostics.

BranchScore.purpose: Branch-specific score payload before and after fusion.
BranchScore.owner: Produced by each branch and fusion strategy.
BranchScore.serialization: Typically not persisted standalone; embedded in evaluation outputs.

WindowSample.purpose: Atomic training/evaluation example representing one detector window.
WindowSample.type_expectations: x shape [window_size, n_features], labels in known ranges.
WindowSample.owner: Built by window builder; consumed by trainers/evaluators.
WindowSample.serialization: Parquet/NPZ dataset shard for reproducible training.

DetectorConfig.purpose: Central config object controlling preprocessing, branches, fusion, postprocessing, and artifact paths.
DetectorConfig.type_expectations: Typed dataclass with explicit defaults and path normalization.
DetectorConfig.serialization: JSON snapshot adjacent to saved model artifacts.

DetectorMetrics.purpose: Structured metric outputs for train/val/test and per-group reporting.
DetectorMetrics.type_expectations: Floats or null where undefined; support counts are integers.
DetectorMetrics.owner: Produced by evaluator and report builder.

overview: 1) Load scenario split CSV/manifest rows produced by M9.2 split rebuilder.
2) Resolve each scenario directory and read PMU multibus CSVs from scenario/pmu.
3) Merge PMU channels by TIMESTAMP, aggregate DATA_PRESENT, and recover EVENT labels (from PMU Event columns and labels/event_frame_labels.csv when available).
4) Apply shared preprocessing: numeric coercion, NaN handling, clipping/scaling, angle-safe transforms, optional positive-sequence and estimator feature adapters.
5) Build sliding windows with deterministic size/stride and per-window metadata.
6) Assign frame/window labels and event-family tags.
7) Generate cyber and physical branch features/scores.
8) Fuse branch scores into p_abnormal plus branch explainability scores.
9) Postprocess with hysteresis/state-machine and extract stable event chunks.
10) Export frame/chunk outputs for downstream classifier/localizer candidate generation.

frame_level.event_coarse: EVENT integer in [0..8] from scenario labels
frame_level.concurrent_representation: Use labels columns IS_CONCURRENT_EVENT and EVENT=6/8 semantics; preserve as metadata flag even in binary mode.

window_level.window_family: derived from window_event_max with concurrent override if any concurrent frame exists

nan_and_data_present_policy.nan_handling: coerce numeric, ffill/bfill where enabled, remaining NaN -> 0, inf -> 0
nan_and_data_present_policy.data_present: aggregate DATA_PRESENT = min across PMUs; maintain per-PMU DATA_PRESENT_* columns when present
nan_and_data_present_policy.rule_integration: cyber heuristics read data_present_ratio and missing bursts
nan_and_data_present_policy.quality_flags: store missing_ratio, stuck_ratio, spike_ratio, timestamp_jitter metrics per window

estimator_assist.source: scenario metadata/scenario_scoring.json and future estimator residual exports
estimator_assist.adapter_contract: EstimatorFeatureAdapter returns optional standardized estimator feature vector appended to shared features when enabled.

downstream_chunk_export_contract.purpose: Provide candidate abnormal intervals for downstream multiclass classifier/localizer.

processing_stages: Load split records and scenario frames
Fit shared preprocessor on train; transform val
Rebuild windows using stored preprocessing schema
Emit chunk proposals for downstream models

coverage_requirements: No split leakage by scenario_id or scenario_family
Val+test must contain at least one scenario from physical-heavy, cyber-heavy, and concurrent/ambiguous families or report explicit fallback pool metrics

governance_notes: Targets are planning gates, not guaranteed immediate results.
Failing any gate blocks phase-3 sign-off and triggers threshold/model review.

unit_tests: DTO validation and serialization round-trip tests
Label mapping tests for frame/window/family/concurrent flags
Angle-safe transform and wrap invariance tests
Fusion strategy tests including estimator-assisted adjustment
Hysteresis and state-machine edge case tests
Report schema tests for detector JSON/MD outputs
integration_tests: m10 train pipeline smoke on tiny split
m10 eval pipeline smoke on tiny split
m10 infer pipeline smoke on one scenario
End-to-end detector on one generated M9 scenario
End-to-end detector on small split set with family-group report assertions
e2e_tests: Generate scenarios -> build splits -> train detector -> eval -> infer -> verify report/chunk contracts

notes: AGENTS.md defines detector architecture, style, testing, and artifact guardrails.
PLANS.md defines Phase 0-3 milestones, dependencies, and acceptance gates.

main_decisions: Reuse and harden the existing src/detectors and m10 pipeline structure instead of creating a parallel architecture.
Adopt explicit domain interfaces and DTO modules while preserving compatibility wrappers.
Use binary detector target (event 0 vs 1..8) with preserved family/concurrent metadata for downstream tasks.
Keep TCN-first physical branch and rules+tabular cyber branch with estimator-assisted feature option.
Formalize calibration, threshold tuning, and chunk-export contracts as first-class pipeline artifacts.
main_risks: Sparse cyber-heavy/concurrent coverage in val/test can destabilize family-level conclusions.
Optional tabular backend dependency (LightGBM) may not be installed and fallback behavior must stay deterministic.
Schema drift between scenario labels and detector ingestion can silently break training labels without contract tests.
